reviews_h2: What people say after we are done

reviews.author: Stephen Kenney
reviews.text: Have to shout out this place and Jeff for the incredible hospitality and service they showed me this morning. My fiancé’s car got a flat in the parking lot across the street at 6am today. I met her to exchange cars and try to fix the flat myself, only to find out the lug-nuts were put on so tight previously there was no way I was doing this manually. On a whim I walked across the street at 7:40am (minutes before this place even officially opens) and met Jeff, he told me to pull it across the street and ended up loosening, replacing and even filling my spare tire up with air before sending me on my way this morning. Triple AAA wasn’t going to get to me for another hour too, so really can’t thanks and praise Jeff enough for his help this morning. Just gained a customer for life in me.

reviews.author: Harley Rose
reviews.text: Been here a few times to have my car worked on and so happy to have finally found a shop that I can trust to get the job done quickly, have always fixed the issues the first time around and always make me feel comfortable and taken care of. Absolutely recommend this shop!

reviews.author: Liana Quinlan
reviews.text: Very friendly and personable staff with good humor. They gave me a very fair quote and were realistic and transparent about the work being done. I paid a lot less than expected and they had multiple replacments done in under 24 hours. All around very amazing, I would reccomend to anyone.

reviews.author: Derek D
reviews.text: These guys are the best. Honest, they do great work, and very communicative with what needs to be done and what they are doing.

reviews.author: Shannon Szura
reviews.text: I’m not one to , but I am very pleased with the service I’ve received. I needed work done on my car.. pretty quickly too.. and researched mechanics near me. D & V came up, So I called them. I was able to bring my car in almost 15 minutes later for a tail light replacement. Sure enough, it was the week of car repairs for my old Nissan, and I brought it back the next weekend for needed break work. Not only are they quick and efficient, but they are friendly, I believe family owned, and they don’t rip you off! They were very clear and informative of telling me what had to be done, and their prices were more than fair. They had my car fixed within a few hours.. and my car drives like new again. I’m very pleased and will be recommending them to my family and friends. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Dan McMillan
reviews.text: These guys are the best. My old van back on the road with a new alternator in under 24 hours at a very very reasonable price. Running great. Thank you!

reviews.author: Mags C
reviews.text: When we moved back up to Monmouth county we never thought about who we would take our car to if we needed to. But after my husband and his friend had a conversation about honest,good mechanics, D&V came up. We dropped it off Saturday morning, my husband spoke to the owner's son and he was very honest about the fact that it wouldn't be able to be worked on till Monday because most parts stores were closed for the weekend. When we called back on Monday it was done and ready to go. They were very polite, answer the phone in a timely manner, and as far as getting your car worked on, I think anyone is apprehensive nowadays, you don't have to be with them. They are fair in their prices and they do a wonderful job. I would highly recommend them . Thank you for taking such good care of our car

reviews.author: Michelle Sauchelli
reviews.text: Great shop! I happen to get a flat tire right in front of this shop today so I pulled in and Jeff brought my car right in to plug the hole. He was extremely friendly and worked on the tire very quickly. Will definitely come back for other services. Appreciate all the help today!

reviews.author: gfunk6
reviews.text: My car broke down on Wednesday in Belmar and I was needing to go back to Philly. AAA dropped the ball and I had to stay overnight and get towed to a repair shop the next day. The first place was booked for next 3 weeks and tow driver suggested/recommended this place. I told Dago the problem with car and that I needed to get on the road back to Philly. He said he would slip me in and get me back on the road. I ended up renting a car because I didn’t know how long it would take. He had it ready by 2:30 and came back next day at 8:30. Couldn’t have been any nicer and HONEST.

reviews.author: Mike DeMarco
reviews.text: My car broke down while on vacation at the shore and they were able to have it fixed within 24 hours when most other places were telling me it would be several days. They did good work and I would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Tian Zii
reviews.text: A small family owned business where the main mechanic is the owner. He is an excellent mechanic who is honest and professional. He did a great job on my car at a very reasonable price. Good shops like this are hard to find!

reviews.author: Eugene Markelov
reviews.text: D and V Auto Repair shop is your neighborhood shop where you can talk to a mechanic who will understand you. I have been coming to this place for over 10 years with various car issues with few vehicles and was always satisfied with the quality of work done, time to do the repairs and the cost of labor. Always A+ service. Definitely recommend to stop by if you need help with your foreign or domestic vehicle.

reviews.author: John Gray
reviews.text: Friendly team, but questionable knowledge or poor business ethics. Two stars. Diagnosed my truck issues as a head gasket leak or crack, thousands of dollars if I wanted it repaired. I went for a second opinion elsewhere and it was a very obvious radiator crack and camshaft position sensor, fixed for a couple hundred dollars. D&V misdiagnosed severely. Also went for new spark plugs and coils in our car, paid almost $700 (crazy expensive), then a few months later went somewhere else for some engine issues. That mechanic said the spark plugs were the wrong ones for my vehicle by the previous mechanic (D&V). Really not happy with that discovery as it was expensive and wrong.

reviews.author: Ray Cox
reviews.text: Excellent, professional, friendly family owned auto shop. Fantastic prices and honest diagnosis. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

reviews.author: Erica English
reviews.text: Super convenient and quick stop for a standard oil change! Staff were friendly and straightforward, will definitely plan to come back for future repairs & maintenance.

reviews.author: Alexis
reviews.text: highly recommend! they were the only place around that picked up the phone when i called and helped fix my splash guard on quick notice (i called at 8:40 and was getting my splash guard fixed at 9:20) awesome service!

reviews.author: tim killion
reviews.text: D & V Auto Reliable, Efficient, Cost Friendly and HONEST! They repaired and replaced what other mechanics and specialist shops could not. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: A MOORE
reviews.text: I am ALWAYS GREETED WARMLY and Receive what I believe is a FAIR ASSESSMENT OF WORK TO BE PERFORMED AND COMPLETION AS ASSESSED!! A FRIEND TOLD ME ABOUT THIS REPAIR SHOP, AND I HAVE BEEN SIMPLY DELIGHTED...... SINCE THAT TIME!!

reviews.author: Arianna
reviews.text: The lady and guy at the office were very nice. Got the work done pretty quickly. Will be taking my car here again in the future.

reviews.author: Tom Ok
reviews.text: Jeff and his father are excellent mechanics and business operators. I highly recommend this shop for auto repairs.

reviews.author: Michael Vandenberg
reviews.text: Called them at 9:00am told them the check engine light can on I was told to bring the car in. took the car to them asked them to check it out. They didn't even look at it and said we don't have a computer to test it. Asked for a local recommendation were I might take it the owner said I don't know anyone who could help!!!
